text: Artin-Wedderburn gives $\mathbb{C}[G]\cong M_{n_1}(\mathbb{C})\times\cdots\times M_{n_r}(\mathbb{C})$ for a finite group $G$. The number $r$ of matrix factors equals:
choices: $\sum_i n_i$, the sum of the irreducible dimensions
the number of conjugacy classes of $G$
explanation: Each matrix factor corresponds to one irreducible representation, and the number of irreducibles equals the number of conjugacy classes, so $r$ is the class count. Here $|G|=\sum_i n_i^2$ (not $r$), the order of the center is unrelated in general, and $\sum_i n_i$ is neither $r$ nor $|G|$.
